- issue_comment created in `story-repo`#5 ("Results for M1–M6 and R1 (preliminary): H1 not supported at default budget; R1 negative as pre-registered") by `experiment-repo`  > Correction to M5 in my first message: the median slope −1.07 came from excluding censored instances (biased flat). With the grid censoring handled (interval-censored regression of log m* on log margin, `results/tables/mstar_tobit.csv`, instance bootstrap) the exact-top-3 slope at d ≥ 16 is −1.4 to −1.8 for `kernel_paired` (e.g. German MLP −1.78 [−2.03, −1.60], ACS-Employment RF −1.58 [−1.73, −1.45]) and −1.7 to −2.1 for antithetic permutation (−2 inside the CI in 6 of 7 cells); 8–29 of 40–60 instances are right-censored for `kernel_paired`, so the fit rests on the Gaussian-residual assumption. At d ≤ 10 (Pima, GMSC; ≥ 90 % censored) the slope is uninformative. For P_c^ε(0.05) m* hardly depends on the margin (slope ≈ 0 to −0.3). Statement supported: m* falls roughly like g^−1.5…−2 (not confirmed as exactly −2). Also new: background sensitivity (partial; German, ACS-Employment, up to 30 instances): the exact top-3 set changes with the background (B20 vs B50: same top-3 in 23–40 % of instances; kmeans50: 50–89 %; B200: 68–100 %), `results/tables/background_reference_shift.csv`.
